profile.headline: Open to work
profile.summary: Bachelor in Computer Science with over 26 years of experience in software development and computer network management. Have gained in-depth experience using Microsoft technologies, while working in various technical positions. Performed as an end to end developer as well as working in capacity service lines oriented to support production environments. Strong experience in Delphi, designing and developing applications that fits an internally developed framework for each enterprise and/or project. SQL Server, excellent understanding of SQL with experience and performance monitoring, analysis and tuning of relational databases, MySQL, experience creating triggers, stored procedures, and complex join statements and migrating data to/from other data sources, Database Administration for SQL Server and MySQL server installations including capacity planning, installing, upgrading, configuration and patching and all functions to provide high availability, high performance and high security, HTML, ASP, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, NodeJs, AngularJs and network management based on Windows OS, along with leveraging best practices and patterns, installation, layout, and maintenance of network components. Plan, design, analyze, and provide technical support for data communications network or group of networks. Strong work ethic, stay committed to deadlines and able to produce quality work in fast pace and high pressure environments. Production and maintenance of high quality documentation, strong interpersonal skills.

positions.title: IT Technical Support and Software Developer
positions.locationName: Houston y alrededores, Texas, Estados Unidos
positions.description: As a team member that we do an excellent and efficient management of computer networks, telephone communications and windows operating system for a total of 100 locations distributed throughout Texas and Chicago in general. Troubleshooting with the functioning of internal company systems, computers, operating system and internal telephony. This a phase of learning the use of technologies for the realization of virtual networks (VPN), such as are firewalls, modems, etc .. Development of information systems (web and desktop) for automation of business management such as system transferring scanned documents from the locations to the corporate for approval.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a member of the development team learned and apply different techniques for Data Mining (Web Scrapping) from other websites. Obtaining also of the necessary expertise in the use of tools like PHP, iMacros and phpQuery.  In this stage I developed my own platform for managing web data extraction.

positions.title: Network/Database Administrator
positions.description: As a Network/Database Administrator was responsible for maintaining the company's networks, optimizing reliability and performance. With the specific responsibilities that include: Ensure the physical operation of the hardware;  maintaining reliable communications between remote locations and the server center;  backups, recovery, including hot server back up;  Ensures reliable operation of the software running on the servers including off hours routines; user management; optimizing performance, space and memory;  recommends purchase of additional hardware and software to maintain performance.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a Software Developer in this stage we make solutions to meet customer requirements through team and individual efforts. I participated in the analysis and composition of requirements, design of architectural and component software features, design and implementation of system, design and implementation of test plan, and documentation of final product. I studied and learned new languages, methodologies, and platforms to meet the needs of the project. I developed applications written in Delphi 5.0 and other development platforms. Also participated in the management of IT projects, obtaining relevant results with projects at the organizational level.
